Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using the 'notify()' method instead of 'notifyAll()' within the synchronized block. This ensures that only one waiting thread is awakened, potentially leading to inefficient thread management.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of MyThread, which uses notify() instead of notifyAll() when waking up waiting threads.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results only confirm that all threads completed their execution and added their messages to the list, but they do not provide evidence that the use of 'notify()' instead of 'notifyAll()' caused any incorrect behavior. The test does not verify that multiple threads were woken up or that the specific thread woken up was the intended one.
